title: Standings computed only for Brasileirão Série A/B/C, not for cup competitions
evidence: tools.c:608 tool_get_standings defaults to Série A and requires season; Copa do Brasil / Libertadores are knockout formats so a league table is not meaningful — R9 ("season standings calculated from match results") is satisfied for the league.
suggestion: None required; note the scope in the tool description (already done).

title: FIFA player data is a single-snapshot (FIFA 19) source
evidence: data.c:557 loads fifa_data.csv (18,207 players); test_main.c:97 asserts the exact count. This is a dataset property, not a defect — player ratings reflect one point in time.
suggestion: None; inherent to the provided dataset.

title: All queries are in-memory linear scans over the full dataset
evidence: tools.c collect()/search loops iterate db->matches (23,954) and db->players (18,207) per call; test_main.c asserts slowest sample query < 2s and aggregate < 5s, so performance criteria are met without indexing.
suggestion: Indexing by team/season would help only at much larger scale; not needed for this spec.
